title: Replace Genz App logo with the user-uploaded image

requirements.text: Replace the current Genz App logo asset with the user-uploaded logo image so the header brand icon uses the uploaded logo while keeping the existing asset path `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`. Ensure the resulting logo file is a 512x512 PNG and looks good when rendered as a 40x40 image with rounded corners in the header.

quotes: use the above image as the apps logo

acceptanceCriteria: The file `frontend/public/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` is replaced/updated to visually match the uploaded logo.
The header continues to load the logo from `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` (no broken images).
The logo renders crisply in the header at 40x40, with no unintended cropping of the central mark/text.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Serve the logo as a static asset from `frontend/public/assets/generated` (no backend image serving).
nonGoals: Do not implement M-Pesa/STK Push payments in this change.
Do not change provider/client contact detail visibility or connection-fee workflows in this change.
Do not redesign the header layout beyond what is required to swap the logo image.

edits: Use the uploaded logo image as the app logo (Gemini_Generated_Image_f7iz8qf7iz8qf7iz.png > genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png)
